comments.author: Curious
comments.body: What is GameCity, exactly? Is it what hosts UWO over in Asia?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Hmm. In doing a little more digging, GameCity seems to be a KOEI-Tecmo owned website (which does have a link to UWO). Nyabraham was apparently voted by fans to be the mayor of "my GAMECITY, [the] official social network service for Japanese fans and visitors of Gamecity". You could "earn [this] statue in a set of limited time Japan only my GAMECITY missions".

So it looks like Nya's a pretty big deal overseas, and the rights do seem to belong solely to KOEI-Tecmo. Still, the chances of this ornament appearing internationally are probably pretty slim. Wouldn't mind being wrong; it's a pretty funny looking decoration.
